dialogue.origin: （こんにちは、今日はよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (Hello, thank you for being here today.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめに、年齢と性別、本日ご相談したいことを教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: （宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for coming.

dialogue.origin: 46歳女性です。実の姉のことでストレスがあります。
dialogue.content: I'm a 46-year-old woman. I'm feeling stressed because of my older sister.

dialogue.origin: 実のお姉さまのことでストレスなんですね。実のお姉さまはどんな方なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you're feeling stressed because of your older sister. Could you tell me what she is like?

dialogue.origin: はい、優しくひとあたりの良い姉ですがかなり心配症です。
dialogue.content: Yes, she's kind and easy to get along with, but she's quite a worrier.

dialogue.origin: かなり心配症…例えばどういった感じなんでしょうか
dialogue.content: Quite a worrier... For example, what does that look like?

dialogue.origin: 様々なことに不安を作り出し、悩みだします。。
dialogue.content: She finds things to be anxious about in all sorts of situations and starts worrying.

dialogue.origin: また頑固で思い込みが強いです
dialogue.content: She's also stubborn and very set in her ways.

dialogue.origin: 優しく人当たりも良い反面、頑なな部分もあるんですね。最近だと、どんなことがあったか伺えますか？
dialogue.content: So, while she is kind and pleasant, she also has a stubborn side. Can you tell me about something that has happened recently?

dialogue.origin: あり過ぎて困ってしまうのですが、
dialogue.content: There are so many examples that it's hard to choose one, but...

dialogue.origin: 一番私がストレスに感じるのは姉の子への心配を私に共有してくることです
dialogue.content: The thing that stresses me out the most is when she shares her worries about her child with me.

dialogue.origin: ネガティブな長文が度々届き読みたくなくなります💦
dialogue.content: I often get long, negative messages from her, and I reach a point where I don't even want to read them.💦

dialogue.origin: それは気分もあまり良くないですね。ネガティブな長文、自分のそういう思いを妹さんであるあなたに協調を求めてくる感じなのでしょうか
dialogue.content: That can't feel very good. With those long, negative messages, does it feel like she's seeking your agreement or validation as her younger sister?

dialogue.origin: 課題を抱えた子でこれまでも色々ありましたが、この春からは姉の元を離れて私のすぐ近所に住みはじめました。気持ちは分かりますが、あまりにも、、、で💦
dialogue.content: Her child has challenges and there has been a lot over the years. Starting this spring, they moved out of my sister’s place and began living very close to me. I understand how she feels, but it's just too much...

dialogue.origin: 協調なのか、よく分からないのですがとにかく心配事をあれこれと、、そして〇〇したらどうか？宜しくね！と細かいことまで提案してきます。
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if she's seeking agreement or not, but she just goes on about all her worries, and then suggests things like, 'How about doing this? Please take care of it!' down to the smallest details.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、お姉さまの心配する気持ちもわかりつつ、少し度が超えている感じなんでしょうかね…あなたはどんなお返事をされるんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So while you can understand your sister's worries, it feels like she's going a bit too far... How do you usually respond?

dialogue.origin: 宜しく、と言われも本人の同意がないと出来ないから、できることはやるよ！と伝えています。
dialogue.content: When she says, "Please take care of it," I tell her that I can't do things without the person's consent, but that I'll do what I can.

dialogue.origin: 返事は↑のような感じです。基本は受けつつ、出来ないことは難しいと
dialogue.content: That's the gist of my replies. I basically agree to what I can, and tell her it's difficult when I can't.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、あなたのおっしゃる通りと思います。あなたはその子の母親ではないですもんね
dialogue.content: That's right, I think you're absolutely correct. After all, you're not the child's mother.

dialogue.origin: 何かと、どうか宜しくと言われてモヤモヤします。。
dialogue.content: Being asked to 'please take care of this and that' all the time leaves me feeling unsettled.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、わかります。課題のあるお子さんでしたら、尚更、ご家族としての思いもあるでしょうし。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. Especially with a child who has challenges, the feelings as a family must be even stronger.

dialogue.origin: はい、可愛い甥で私の子ども達とも仲が良いので手伝うのはもちろんなのですが、あまりにも姉の具体的な希望が細かくて困っています、、
dialogue.content: Yes, he's my dear nephew and he gets along well with my children, so of course I'm willing to help, but my sister's specific requests are so detailed that it's troubling.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: あなたもお母様であるんですね。そしたら、尚更、お姉さまのお母様という気持ちも分かるし、でも、お姉様と反対の考えの時も当然あるでしょうね。
dialogue.content: You're a mother yourself, aren't you? In that case, you can understand your sister's feelings as a mother all the more, but naturally, there will be times when your views differ from hers.

dialogue.origin: そして、先回りして心配ばかりしているのでネガティブ過ぎるのが疲れます💦
dialogue.content: And she's always anticipating problems and worrying, and her negativity is exhausting. 💦

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…先回りしすぎるのも、同じ母親としてどうかなって思ってしまいますよね。ちなみに、あなたは子育てでどんなことを大事にされてDるんでsほうか？
dialogue.content: I see... As a fellow mother, you must wonder if she's being too preemptive. By the way, what do you value most in raising your own children?

dialogue.origin: はい、わたしにも課題を抱えた子がおり毎日大変です。ですが、私は姉とはタイプが違い本人に任せたいという考えです
dialogue.content: Yes, I also have a child with challenges, and every day is a struggle. But I'm a different type from my sister; I believe in letting my child handle things themselves.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、子育ては課題の連続ですよね。頑張っておられますね。また、あなたの考えも素晴らしいと思います
dialogue.content: I see. Raising children is a series of challenges, isn't it? You're doing a great job. And I think your approach is wonderful.

dialogue.origin: なるべく本人に任せることに加えて、信じてあげたいと思っています。
dialogue.content: In addition to letting them handle things as much as possible, I want to believe in them.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、信じるって大切ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, believing in them is so important, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、そう思ってます。
dialogue.content: Yes, I believe so.

dialogue.origin: 難しいことですが、信じて本人の気持ちをしっかり待っておられる、とは私も見習わないとです
dialogue.content: It's a difficult thing to do, but the way you trust and patiently wait for them is something I feel I could learn from as well.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。わたしも出来たり、出来なかったりですが心がけています。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Sometimes I can do it, and sometimes I can't, but I always try to keep it in mind.

dialogue.origin: 子育てに正解はないと言いますから、試行錯誤の連続ですね
dialogue.content: They say there's no single right way to raise children, so it's a continuous process of trial and error.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.origin: あなたの、出来たり出来なかったり、でも心がけていらっしゃる、という気持ちはお姉さまにとってはどんな感じに思っているんでしょうね？
dialogue.content: I wonder how your sister perceives your 'sometimes I can, sometimes I can't, but I'm trying' approach?

dialogue.origin: あなたから見て、何かお姉さまにもあなたのように心掛けているようなことはあるように思いますか？
dialogue.content: From your perspective, do you think your sister has anything she tries to keep in mind, like you do?

dialogue.origin: ご質問の意味を正しく理解していなかったら恐縮ですが、そうですね、、姉の場合は常な心配しているように感じます。そして、失敗しないようにあれこれ策を提案してきて、どうか協力して…と言うので
dialogue.content: I'm sorry if I'm not understanding your question correctly, but... well, in my sister's case, I feel she's constantly worrying. And she proposes all sorts of measures to prevent failure, asking me to please cooperate...

dialogue.origin: 私には子の自立を妨げてるいるように感じます。
dialogue.content: To me, it feels like she's hindering her child's independence.

dialogue.origin: 常に心配　　でした
dialogue.content: Constantly worrying—that was my point.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、あなたはそう感じておられるんですね。常に心配し、お子さんの自立を妨げているんじゃないかと…そういった考えを実際にお姉さまに話したことはございますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how you feel. That she's constantly worrying and perhaps hindering her child's independence... Have you ever actually told your sister about these thoughts?

dialogue.origin: はっきり言うと角が立つかな？と思い、姉の気持ちはよく分かる、心配も当然だけど、私には甥は自分で出来る子に見えるよなどとは伝えています。
dialogue.content: I was worried it might cause friction if I said it directly, so I've said things like, 'I understand how you feel, and it's natural to worry, but to me, our nephew seems capable of doing things on his own.'

dialogue.origin: 少しづつの歩みだけど、信じよう、と
dialogue.content: And, 'He's making progress step-by-step, so let's believe in him.'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、妹さんのお立場でしっかりお姉さまに伝えているんですね。お姉さまはどんな反応でしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, so as her sister, you're firmly conveying that to her. What is her reaction?

dialogue.origin: 姉も、一応はそうだね！と返してくれますが、その後も全く変化ありません。このような事をよく繰り返しています。。
dialogue.content: My sister does reply with something like, 'Yes, you're right!', but then absolutely nothing changes afterward. We repeat this cycle often.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…全く変化がないと、あなたも自分の考えを理解してくれていないように感じちゃいますね。なぜお姉さまは全く変化ないんでしょうかね？
dialogue.content: I see... When there's no change at all, it must make you feel like she isn't understanding your point of view. I wonder why your sister doesn't change at all?

dialogue.origin: 私には何故かは分かりませんが、思考の癖や自分の行動が正しいと思っているのではないでしょうか？？
dialogue.content: I don't know why, but I suspect it's a habit of thought, or that she believes her own actions are correct.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お姉さまは頑固な一面があるっておっしゃってましたね
dialogue.content: I see. You did mention that your sister has a stubborn side.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうすると、あなたのお考えにも一応耳を傾けるものの、やっぱり自分の考えが正しいと思ってしまって、変化もないんでしょうね。あなたは、お姉さまにどんな変化があったら一番良いと考えますか？
dialogue.content: So she listens to your ideas to some extent, but ultimately believes her own view is correct, which is why there's no change. What kind of change in her would you most like to see?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないですね。変化としては自分の行動が先回りだと気づくことでしょうか？あとは、
dialogue.content: That might be it. As for a change, perhaps for her to realize that her actions are too preemptive? And also...

dialogue.origin: はい、あとは？
dialogue.content: Yes, and also?

dialogue.origin: 自らが未来を不安に想像しているだけだと気づいて欲しいと感じます。
dialogue.content: I would like her to realize that she's the one imagining an anxious future.

dialogue.origin: これは私の考えなので正しいかはわかりませんが
dialogue.content: This is just my opinion, so I don't know if it's correct, but...

dialogue.origin: 心配して悩みを創り出しているのは自分だと気づいてもらえたら、私は助かります
dialogue.content: It would be a great help to me if she could realize that she herself is the one creating these problems by worrying.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、誰も自分の考えを100％自信もって正しい！なんて言えませんもんね。あなたはお姉さまのこと、とてもよく考えて、良い方向に行くように願っておられると思いました
dialogue.content: That's right, no one can say with 100% confidence that their own way of thinking is absolutely correct. It's clear you think a great deal about your sister and truly wish for things to go in a better direction for her.

dialogue.origin: はい、家族なので。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes, because we're family. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ストレスを感じておられるあなたですが、素晴らしいご家族だと思います。きっとお姉さまも、そんなあなただから頼りにしてしまうんだと思います。とは言え、あなたも母親として迷い苦しみながらの子育て中ですから、ご自分の考えをずっと大事にしていただきたいです
dialogue.content: Even though you're feeling stressed, I think you're a wonderful sister. Your sister probably relies on you precisely because of the person you are. That said, you are also in the midst of raising your own children, with your own struggles and doubts, so I want you to continue to cherish your own way of thinking.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。家族仲は悪くないのですがストレスなのも事実で出来るだけストレスをなくしたいです。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. Our family gets along well, but it's also a fact that this is stressful, and I want to reduce that stress as much as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、ストレスを軽減できるといいですね。何かお好きなことやホッとする場所や時間は最近取れていますか？
dialogue.content: Of course, it would be good to be able to reduce that stress. Have you been able to find time recently for things you enjoy, or for places and moments that help you relax?

dialogue.origin: はい！意識して仕事も減らしリラックスできるようにしています。
dialogue.content: Yes! I've been consciously reducing my work to make time to relax.

dialogue.origin: それは良かったです！リラックス大事ですよね。どんなことしていらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.content: That's wonderful! Relaxation is so important, isn't it? What kinds of things do you do?

dialogue.origin: 好きなカフェに行ったり、景色の良い場所に散歩したりです
dialogue.content: I go to my favorite cafes or take walks in places with nice scenery.

dialogue.origin: 素敵ですね〜カフェはお一人でのんびりされているんですか？景色の良い場所もリラックスできそうですね
dialogue.content: That sounds lovely. Do you relax at the cafe by yourself? A place with a nice view sounds very relaxing, too.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 一人か愛犬とです
dialogue.content: Either alone or with my dog.

dialogue.origin: 一人になるお時間は子育てしているとなかなか難しいですが、あなたは上手に撮られていますね。愛犬もご一緒だと尚更癒されそうです
dialogue.content: It's often difficult to get time alone when you're raising children, but you're managing it well. And being with your dog must be even more soothing.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。とはいえ、度々来る姉からのLINEでやはりモヤモヤが湧きます、、
dialogue.content: That's true. That said, the frequent messages from my sister still stir up that unsettled feeling.

dialogue.origin: お姉さまも何かあなたのようにご自分を大切にできる瞬間があると良いですね。忙しい子育て中はそういうことが本当に難しいと思いますが…
dialogue.content: It would be nice if your sister also had moments where she could take care of herself, like you do. I know that can be really difficult when you're busy raising children...

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、姉は社長業もあるので目が回るほど忙しいこともあり視野が狭まっているかもしれません、、、
dialogue.content: That's true... She's also a company president, so sometimes she's dizzyingly busy, which may have narrowed her perspective.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。はい、きっとあなたのお気づきの通りと思います。お姉さま自身の視野が狭くなって、お子さんと直面することが多いのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. Yes, I'm sure you're right. Your sister's own perspective may have narrowed, causing her to focus too intensely on her child.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうかもしれないですね。。
dialogue.content: Yes, that might be the case.

dialogue.origin: 今日お話しさせていただき、あなたはとても客観的に物事を見て感じ、ご自身のお考えを大事にされていると感じました。今度、お姉さまとゆっくり子育ての話は抜きでカフェや散歩で楽しい時間が取れたら良いですね
dialogue.content: Speaking with you today, I felt that you view things very objectively and truly value your own way of thinking. It might be nice if you and your sister could take some time to enjoy a cafe or a walk together, without talking about parenting for once.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はい、やってみます！
dialogue.content: Thank you. Yes, I'll give it a try!

dialogue.origin: いかがですか？お姉さまとできそうでしょうか
dialogue.content: How does that sound? Do you think that's something you could do with your sister?

dialogue.origin: 母親同士ではなく、姉妹としてお時間を共有してみると、何かお姉さまも気づきがあるかもしれませんよ
dialogue.content: If you share time together as sisters, not just as mothers, your sister might have some realizations of her own.

dialogue.origin: 離れているのですぐには難しくもありますが、出来るように挑戦したいと思います
dialogue.content: We live apart, so it may be hard to do right away, but I'd like to try to make it happen.

dialogue.origin: そうですね！話してみます。
dialogue.content: You're right! I'll talk to her about it.

dialogue.origin: はい、きっと素敵な時間になると思います。今日はお時間になりますが、何か他にございませんか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm sure it will be a wonderful time. Our time is about up for today, but is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: はい！大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: No, I'm fine.

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話できて良かったです。また、子育てのこと、何でも話したくなったらいらしてください。あなたのこと、陰ながら応援しています！
dialogue.content: I'm glad we could talk today. Please come back anytime you want to talk about parenting or anything else. I'll be rooting for you!

dialogue.origin: お優しい言葉をありがとうございます。また宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your kind words. I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそです。それでは、終了とさせていただきますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: The pleasure was all mine. Well then, we'll conclude our session here. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

topic.sub: 姉との過剰な心配の共有問題
